## Use case

What are you trying to accomplish, and from where (a coding agent, the CLI, the web UI)?

## Proposed behavior

Include an example command, MCP call or screen, and the expected output if useful.

## Data source

For new registries, providers or prices, link the public documentation or API that would supply the
data, and say whether it needs an account or API key.
